input.summary: Repeat the upper-left horseshoe until bonus reaches 5x, then use the safer Jack and Queen banks to build a large multiplied bonus.

quickInfo.name: Held multiplier
quickInfo.summary: Each upper-left horseshoe advances the bonus multiplier toward 5x, and the multiplier holds between balls.

quickInfo.name: Maximum bonus
quickInfo.summary: Card and target progress builds base bonus to 29,000, which is worth 145,000 at 5x.

quickInfo.name: Card ranks
quickInfo.summary: Aces use the top star rollovers, Kings use the upper-left captive balls, Queens use the upper-right bank, Jacks use the two lower side pairs, and Tens use the alternating center rollover.

quickInfo.name: Repeated banks
quickInfo.summary: Completing Jacks or Queens scores 10,000 the first time and 20,000 on later completions.

quickInfo.name: Card memory
quickInfo.summary: Completed card ranks hold between balls, while base bonus resets after each ball.

steps.text: Test the staged flippers with short presses before the first fast return.
Move the ball to the right flipper when the transfer is controlled.
Shoot the upper-left horseshoe to advance the held bonus multiplier.
Repeat the horseshoe until the multiplier reaches 5x.
From the left flipper, shoot the upper-right Queen bank when its return is controlled.
Use either lower Jack pair when the Queen shot is unavailable.
Repeat the completed Jack and Queen banks for their increased 20,000 awards.
When the left spinner lights through normal progress, shoot it only from a controlled angle.
Preserve the 5x multiplier and card progress across later balls.

fallback.title: Wide Jack-bank route
fallback.when: Use this plan when the upper-left horseshoe or Queen-bank return is unreliable.

steps.text: Stop forcing the failed upper shot.
Choose the lower Jack pair on the same side as the controlled flipper.
Shoot the wide target area instead of the center triangle.
Complete Jacks to add bonus and card progress.
Repeat the bank after its completion value rises to 20,000.

alternatives.title: Card-rank completion
alternatives.when: Use this plan when one held card rank is close to completion and its shot is safer than the current bank repeat.

steps.text: Read which card rank is incomplete.
Use the matching feature: top rollovers for Aces, captive balls for Kings, Queen bank, Jack pairs, or center Tens rollover.
Complete the rank for its 10,000 award and held progress.
Return to Jack and Queen repeats after the safe rank is complete.
Repeat the upper-left horseshoe until the multiplier reaches 5x.
Complete Jack and Queen banks to build base bonus.
Repeat those banks for their higher completion values.
Add safe card and target hits until base bonus reaches 29,000.
Protect the ball and collect the multiplied bonus at the drain.

playfieldReferences.label: Multiplier horseshoe
playfieldReferences.description: The horseshoe that advances the held bonus multiplier toward 5x.

playfieldReferences.label: Queen bank
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-right target bank used for repeatable card scoring.

techniques.name: Flipper staging
techniques.instruction: Use a short button press to operate the inner flipper first. Press fully only when the outer flipper must also move.

techniques.name: Right-flipper horseshoe setup
techniques.instruction: Settle the ball on the right flipper before the upper-left horseshoe shot. Do not shoot it from a weak moving-ball angle.

techniques.name: Same-side Jack shot
techniques.instruction: Shoot the wide Jack pair that is across from the active flipper. Track the return on the same half of the wide playfield.

cautions.issue: The staged double flippers can open a scissors drain when both pairs move at the wrong time.
cautions.response: Learn the short-press stage before making precision shots. Use a full press only when both flippers are necessary.

cautions.issue: The single center drop target below the Tens rollover can return the ball through the center gap.
cautions.response: Do not shoot it directly. Collect Tens only when a natural feed reaches the alternating rollover.

cautions.issue: Target and bumper returns remain dangerous even when the wide playfield makes some side-bank shots appear safe.
cautions.response: Test one return before repeating a bank. Stop the repeat if the ball begins to cross toward the opposite drain.

input.simpleOverview: Pokerino carries Bonus X between balls and raises it through the upper-left horseshoe. Repeat that horseshoe until Bonus X reaches 5x, then use the safer Jack and Queen banks to add to base bonus and score their larger repeat-completion awards.
input.overview: Pokerino carries Bonus X between balls while base bonus resets. Use controlled right-flipper shots through the upper-left horseshoe to reach 5x, then repeat the upper-right Queen bank or lower Jack pairs for bonus and 20,000 repeat awards. Protect the multiplied bonus rather than forcing the captive-ball Kings.
